en: I swept the kitchen this morning.
I did not sweep my room yesterday.
You (m.) swept our house very well.
You (m.) did not sweep the floor in the kitchen.
You (f.) swept the stairs with the green broom.

lat: ma shettebtish l-berkuna l-bare7 f l-3shiya
en: You (f.) did not sweep the balcony yesterday evening.
He swept his shop in the morning.
He did not sweep the street in front of the door.
She swept the living room before lunch.
She did not sweep the children's room.
We swept the terrace with your brother yesterday.
We did not sweep the whole house today.
You (pl.) swept your office in the morning.
You (pl.) did not sweep the building stairs.
They swept the school yard today.
They did not sweep their shop yesterday.
I sweep my room every day.
I do not sweep the terrace every day.
You (m.) always sweep the kitchen quickly.
You (m.) do not always sweep the floor well.
You (f.) sweep the house every Friday.
You (f.) do not sweep the balcony in the rain.
He sweeps the shop before work.

lat: ma kayshettebsh d-dar dyalu kul nhar
ar: ما كيشطبش الدار ديالو كل نهار
en: He does not sweep his house every day.
She sweeps the living room every Sunday.
She does not sweep the stairs of the house.
We always sweep the guest room.
We do not sweep the street at night.
You (pl.) always sweep the kitchen after dinner.

lat: ma katshettbush d-dar kul nhar l-7edd
ar: ما كتشطبوش الدار كل نهار الحد
en: You (pl.) do not sweep the house every Sunday.
They sweep the courtyard early every morning.
They do not always sweep their office.
I am going to sweep my room now.
I am not going to sweep the terrace today.

lat: ghadi tshetteb l-kuzina ghedda f s-sba7
en: You (m.) are going to sweep the kitchen tomorrow morning.

lat: ma ghadish tshetteb d-dar bu7dek l-yum
ar: ما غاديش تشطب الدار بوحدك اليوم
en: You (m.) are not going to sweep the house alone today.
You (f.) are going to sweep the stairs in the afternoon.
You (f.) are not going to sweep the balcony now.
He is going to sweep his shop tomorrow.
He is not going to sweep the street today.

lat: ghadi tshetteb s-salon l-yum f l-lil
en: She is going to sweep the living room tonight.
She is not going to sweep the floor now.
We are going to sweep the whole house tomorrow.
We are not going to sweep the terrace today.
You (pl.) are going to sweep the kitchen after lunch.
You (pl.) are not going to sweep the school today.
They are going to sweep the courtyard after work.

lat: ma ghadish yshettbu l-bit dyalhum daba
ar: ما غاديش يشطبو البيت ديالهم دابا
en: They are not going to sweep their room now.
